steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Source analysis is a core skill in OCR J280 — especially for visual and material culture | Key Fact: Classical sources include literary texts, visual sources (vase paintings, sculpture) and material evidence | Key Fact: Always consider content, provenance and context when analysing a source | Key Fact: Literary sources may be biased by genre, purpose or audience
